verdict.rationale: Vanta documents continuous monitoring that flags gaps and suggests fixes, and it offers registrable real-time webhooks for events, so findings can be pushed out of the platform. Nothing shows native Slack, email or ticketing delivery of control-failure alerts, or that webhook events cover failing tests or drift. The status-page email is about Vanta's own incidents, not customer findings. missing for 10: native Slack/email/ticketing alerts for failing tests or drift, confirmation that webhook events include test failures, documented remediation context in alerts, independent corroboration.
